intro: Everything about your workforce, managed in one system.
speakerNotes: Today I will show how this system helps HR manage employees, attendance, leave, salary and more, all in one place.

intro: 5 groups covering HR and Material Management operations.
speakerNotes: These 5 groups cover the full journey of HR operations and complete Material Management from requisition to inventory.

intro: One screen that shows how your workforce is doing today.

cards.title: Today at glance
cards.text: Total employees, active loans, people on leave, monthly payroll.

cards.title: Attendance view
cards.text: Who is present or absent, by employee type and project site.

cards.title: Alerts and tasks
cards.text: Pending approvals, clearances, and visas or passports expiring soon.

whyItHelps: HR spots problems early without opening every section.
speakerNotes: Think of this as the control room. In one look, HR sees who is in, who is on leave and what needs action.

intro: The complete list of everyone who works for the company.

cards.title: Employee profiles
cards.text: Personal, job, department and ID details kept in one record.

cards.title: Staff and labour
cards.text: Separate lists for staff, labour and unfinished entries.

cards.title: Status at glance
cards.text: Active status, passport, visa and labour-authority fee details.

steps: Search, filter or update any time
whyItHelps: All employee information is in one place, easy to find.
speakerNotes: Every other section uses this list, so details are entered once and used everywhere.

intro: Employees apply for leave and managers approve it step by step.

cards.title: Approval steps
cards.text: Requests go to Project Director, Director, then Managing Director.

cards.title: Leave overview
cards.text: See leave by type and by department.

cards.title: Related requests
cards.text: Leave salary, comp-off, announcements and attendance corrections.

whyItHelps: Everyone knows where a request is and who must act next.
speakerNotes: No more paper forms or chasing. Each approver sees the request and the employee sees the status.

intro: Prepare, approve and pay salaries each month.

cards.title: Staff and labour
cards.text: Separate payroll for staff and for labour workers.

cards.title: Monthly or custom
cards.text: Run the monthly closing, or an extra run when needed.

cards.title: Clear status
cards.text: Each run shows approval status, totals and a locked mark.

whyItHelps: Salaries are processed in an organised and traceable way.
speakerNotes: Each month HR runs payroll, management approves it, salaries are paid and the record is locked.

intro: Daily attendance of every employee, recorded and checked.

cards.title: Daily record
cards.text: Check-in, lunch, check-out, hours worked and late arrivals.

cards.title: Marked automatically
cards.text: No punch by 10:30 AM means Absent; punch makes them Present.

cards.title: Easy corrections
cards.text: Add or edit records, set shifts and holidays, export to Excel.

steps: Employee punches at the attendance machine
HR checks and corrects if needed
whyItHelps: Accurate attendance, which also feeds salary and leave.
speakerNotes: Employees punch at site or office. The system marks attendance for HR, and HR can fix exceptions.

intro: Give employee loans and track every repayment.

cards.title: Issue a loan
cards.text: Record the loan type, amount, start month and end month.

cards.title: Track repayment
cards.text: See active loans, amount outstanding and monthly deduction.

cards.title: Clear next step
cards.text: Each loan shows its status and who needs to act next.

steps: Monthly deduction until the end month
whyItHelps: No loan is forgotten, and repayments stay accurate.
speakerNotes: HR can see every loan, how much is left and what the next step is. A flowchart shows how a loan is paid out.

intro: Request, approve and apply salary increases.

cards.title: Request tracking
cards.text: See requests waiting, approved, applied to payroll, and total.

cards.title: Easy search
cards.text: Find any request by employee name or code.

cards.title: Create and export
cards.text: Raise a new increment and export the list.

whyItHelps: Approved raises reach the salary correctly and on time.
speakerNotes: A raise is not just promised. It is approved here and then applied to payroll.

intro: Employees can report salary mistakes and get them corrected.

cards.title: Raise a claim
cards.text: A salary issue is recorded with month, category and amount.

cards.title: Two approvals
cards.text: First HR reviews, then the Managing Director approves.

cards.title: Clear outcome
cards.text: Totals of approved corrections and rejected claims.

whyItHelps: Salary mistakes are fixed fairly, with a proper record.
speakerNotes: If an employee believes their salary was wrong, the claim goes through a clear review and the result is recorded.

intro: Handle warnings and disciplinary cases in a fair, recorded way.

cards.title: Cases and severity
cards.text: Each case has a reference, a violation and a severity.

cards.title: Automatic or manual
cards.text: Late-arrival cases are raised automatically; HR can also start one.

cards.title: Clear status
cards.text: Pending HR, pending management, issued, acknowledged, meeting requested, rejected.

steps: Employee acknowledges or asks for a meeting
whyItHelps: Every action is consistent, fair and recorded.
speakerNotes: Nothing is verbal. Each warning has a reference, a reviewer and the employee's response.

intro: Manage travel tickets and ticket allowances.

cards.title: Eligibility
cards.text: See who is eligible for a ticket under their policy.

cards.title: Ticket or cash
cards.text: Company books the ticket, or a cash allowance is given.

cards.title: Cost tracking
cards.text: Cancelled tickets and total ticket cost are tracked.

steps: Ticket booked or cash allowance chosen
whyItHelps: Travel benefits are fair and the cost is under control.
speakerNotes: HR knows who has a ticket benefit, how it was given and what it cost.

intro: Paperless forms for hiring requests and performance reviews.

cards.title: Two form types
cards.text: Department staffing requests and employee performance appraisals.

cards.title: Track each form
cards.text: Who submitted it, for whom, priority and status.

cards.title: Quick start
cards.text: Create a new form in a few clicks.

whyItHelps: Less paperwork and every form is easy to find.
speakerNotes: Instead of printed forms and emails, everything is submitted and followed up here.

intro: A clear checklist when an employee leaves the company.

cards.title: Exit requests
cards.text: Records the exit type and the last working day.

cards.title: Department sign-off
cards.text: Each department confirms its part, including returned company assets.

cards.title: Current stage
cards.text: See where each clearance is stuck or complete.

whyItHelps: Nothing is missed before final settlement.
speakerNotes: Before someone leaves, every department confirms they have no pending issue and all assets are returned.

intro: Bring back employees returning from leave or re-employment.

cards.title: Rejoining record
cards.text: Employee, type of rejoining and rejoining date.

cards.title: Status
cards.text: See if it is complete and who processed it.

cards.title: Quick start
cards.text: Add a new rejoining in a few clicks.

whyItHelps: Returning employees are re-started properly with a record.
speakerNotes: When someone comes back, HR records it here so their status is updated correctly.

intro: Ready-made reports for HR and management.

cards.title: Salary and money
cards.text: Monthly salary, leave salary, payroll, allowances, GOSI, end-of-service, loans.

cards.title: People attendance
cards.text: All employees, attendance summary, leave report, site-wise report.

cards.title: Documents rules
cards.text: Expiring documents, passports, visas, clearances, vehicles.

whyItHelps: Management gets answers quickly, without manual counting.
speakerNotes: Whatever management asks for, there is usually a ready report. Just pick it and export.

intro: Plan company meetings and keep a record of them.

cards.title: Schedule
cards.text: Set the title, host, organizer, place or link, and participants.

cards.title: Who attends
cards.text: Choose the target audience for each meeting.

cards.title: Meeting status
cards.text: See total, upcoming and completed meetings.

whyItHelps: Meetings are organised and nothing is forgotten.
speakerNotes: HR can arrange meetings with the right people and keep a simple history.

intro: A record of every payroll action, for trust and checking.

cards.title: Success or failure
cards.text: See how many actions succeeded, failed or were rejected.

cards.title: Easy filters
cards.text: Filter by type of action, status and date.

cards.title: Full details
cards.text: Time, action, who did it, status and reason.

whyItHelps: Everything done on payroll can be checked later.
speakerNotes: If anyone asks who did what on payroll and when, the answer is here.

intro: Set the salary rules once, and payroll follows them.

cards.title: GOSI insurance
cards.text: Set company and employee shares for Bahraini and expatriate staff.

cards.title: End-of-service
cards.text: Two rates, depending on years of service.

cards.title: LMRA fee
cards.text: A monthly labour-authority fee for expatriate employees.

whyItHelps: Rules are set in one place and old payrolls stay unchanged.
speakerNotes: These are the rules behind every salary. When a rule changes, HR updates it once and only future payrolls are affected.

intro: Site teams ask for materials and buyers take it forward.
whyItHelps: Every material need is visible from request to procurement.
speakerNotes: Site teams raise requests for needed materials, which move to the procurement queue once approved.

submodules.name: Material Request Dashboard
submodules.desc: Overview of material requests, purchasing and accounts flow.
bullets: Search and filter requests by status
See MR number, site, required date
Raise a New Request or Export the list

submodules.name: Procurement Queue
submodules.desc: Requisitions needing external vendor purchase after the warehouse stock check.
bullets: See project, site, material and quantity needed
Filter by priority
Send an item to RFQ or Create a Global RFQ

intro: Create RFQs, compare vendor quotations, and issue linked purchase orders.
whyItHelps: Quotes are compared fairly and orders are traceable.
speakerNotes: Suppliers provide competitive quotes before approved items become official purchase orders.

submodules.name: RFQ / Quotations
submodules.desc: Create RFQs, send to vendors and compare quotations.
bullets: Separate tabs for Materials and Assets
Track every RFQ by status
Search any RFQ quickly

submodules.name: Purchase Orders
submodules.desc: Zoho Books purchase orders linked to material and asset requests.
bullets: Filter All / MR / AR purchase orders
See vendor, amount, delivery date and status
Sync Zoho POs or raise a New PO

intro: Track delivery fulfilment, shipment dispatch timelines, and store receipt inspection.
whyItHelps: Nothing arrives or ships without a record.
speakerNotes: Shipments are monitored end-to-end so sites know when goods arrive and verify quality on delivery.

submodules.name: Deliveries & Shipments
submodules.desc: Track delivery fulfilment, shipments and dispatch timeline across projects.
bullets: Stock status per request (e.g. In Stock)
Required vs needed dates
Progress bar with stage and percentage

submodules.name: Receipts (GRN)
submodules.desc: Store keeper receives material, checks quality and inwards it to store.
bullets: Each PO shows QC status and store status
Spot partially received items
Sync Zoho POs

intro: Standard catalogued materials and multi-tier stock levels across projects.
whyItHelps: One clean master list and live stock numbers.
speakerNotes: Central material codes prevent duplicate items, while inventory gives real-time stock availability.

submodules.name: Material Master
submodules.desc: One master list for Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and HVAC materials with cost code mapping.
bullets: Filter by discipline, segment, category, UOM and class
Each material has code, specification and unit
Add Material or Export to Excel

submodules.name: Inventory & Stock
submodules.desc: Multi-tier stock tracking: on-hand, usable, reserved and on-order.
bullets: See stock status and free-to-allocate quantity
Search by category or status
Add Stock (Batch) and view Activity Logs

intro: Manage approved trade suppliers and track invoice settlements.
whyItHelps: Vendors are organised and bills are settled on time.
speakerNotes: Keep vendor directories up to date and match invoices directly against orders for seamless settlement.

submodules.name: Vendors / Suppliers
submodules.desc: All project vendors, contact details and trade categories in one place.
bullets: Code, contact person, email, phone and city
Category tag per vendor (steel, paints, concrete, MEP...)
Add New Vendor or Refresh

submodules.name: Accounts & Bills
submodules.desc: Material invoices, payment approvals and vendor settlements.
bullets: Search by MR#, LPO#, vendor or invoice
Four tabs follow the bill from entry to settlement
Sync with accounts

intro: Request, allocate and monitor site machinery and heavy tools.
whyItHelps: Machinery and tools are tracked with their suppliers.
speakerNotes: Every machine and piece of equipment is inventoried and tracked across requests and returns.

submodules.name: Asset List
submodules.desc: Machinery assets and their preferred suppliers.
bullets: Asset code, specification, unit (month, shift, pour)
Preferred vendor shown per asset
Add Asset or Export

submodules.name: Operational Assets Request
submodules.desc: Request, track and manage site machinery, tools and equipment.
bullets: Filter by status and stock status
List or grid view
Raise a New Request

intro: Complete visibility of available and deployed construction tools and equipment.
whyItHelps: Always know which assets are free and which are in use.
speakerNotes: Site managers see which tools are on site and which are available in central storage at a glance.

submodules.name: Operational Assets Inventory
bullets: Asset code, name, category and quantities
See what is available vs in use
Add Stock Entry

intro: Questions?
speakerNotes: Thank you for your time. I am happy to answer any questions about any of the sections we walked through.
